name: Kibookal Urban Graffiti Comic Style
composition: Dynamic comic framing with strong diagonals; brick/concrete or shutter backdrop; bold subject pushed to the foreground; spray drips, tags and halftone in the gutters.
style_palette: High-saturation spray colours (electric blue, hot magenta, acid yellow, red) over concrete grey and black outline; halftone dots; one wall-texture neutral.
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal urban-graffiti comic image of [SUBJECT]: render the subject as a bold street-art comic hero — thick black outlines with spray drips, vivid spray-can colour, halftone shading, tag-style lettering and a brick/concrete/shutter backdrop. Strong diagonals and motion, gritty wall texture, high energy. It should feel like a comic page sprayed onto a city wall — punchy, youthful, alive.
negative: no soft watercolour, no pastel, no photoreal, no calm storybook, no clean corporate vector, no gradients-without-halftone
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
